plan.overall_assessment: The preprocessing pipeline successfully transformed the raw financial time‑series dataset. The Date column was cast to a proper datetime type, duplicate rows were verified and none were removed, extreme numeric values were clipped using IQR bounds, year/month/day components were extracted from the Date, and all numeric price and volume fields were standardized with a zero‑mean/unit‑variance scaling, producing new *_scaled columns. The original raw columns were then removed, leaving a richer feature set for modeling.
quality_improvements: Converted Date from object to datetime for accurate temporal handling
Ensured dataset contains no duplicate records
Clipped outliers in price and volume columns using IQR method
Created separate year, month, and day features from Date
Standardized numeric features to have zero mean and unit variance
